title: Industrial Emergency Showers, Eye and Face Fountains and Combination Units — Specification ( First Revision )
clause_1_scope: This standard prescribes minimum performance requirements for emergency showers, eye and face fountains, combination units Self-contained eyewash and Personal eyewash units.
clause_3_terminology: Eye and Face Fountains and Combination Units

marking_requirements: The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark.
